configEncryptionKey.title: Settings encryption key missing
configEncryptionKey.description: CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set (or invalid) in the .env file: the passwords and keys entered in Settings are stored in plain text in the database. Add a key (openssl rand -hex 32) and restart the application.

smtpWithoutTls.title: SMTP without encryption
smtpWithoutTls.description: The SMTP server is configured without TLS and without certificate check: e-mails and the SMTP login travel in plain text. Choose TLS or SSL in Settings → E-mail.

temporaryAuthSecret.title: Temporary authentication secret
temporaryAuthSecret.description: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is missing from the .env file: a temporary secret is used and every session will be lost at the next restart. Run the installer again or set it in .env.

captchaNotConfigured.title: Captcha on but not configured
captchaNotConfigured.description: The captcha is on without its keys (ALTCHA: secrets in the .env file; Turnstile or reCAPTCHA: site key and secret key): the check is skipped at sign-in.

fcmInvalid.title: Invalid Firebase service account
fcmInvalid.description: FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON is not a valid Firebase service account: the mobile app push notifications are not sent.
